summary: Sibanye Stillwater Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing its operating and financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026. The report covers record revenue of R90bn, adjusted EBITDA of R31.8bn, profit of R18.8bn, and declaration of an interim dividend of 201 SA cents per share. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or strategic review. No corporate action requiring classification under special-situations categories is present. The filing is purely informational in nature with no deal terms or structural changes.
